question: Mr. Q starts from Point Z and drives 7 km towards the north. He then takes a left turn, drives 9 km, turns right and drives 6 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 7 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 13 km and stops at Point A. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Z again? (All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given, 

Mr. Q starts from Point Z and drives 7 km towards the north.

He then takes a left turn, drives 9 km, turns right and drives 6 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 7 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 13 km and stops at Point A.
